title: Inhibition of the HMGB1-RAGE Axis Attenuates Microglial Inflammation and Ameliorates Hypoxia-Induced Cognitive Impairment.
authors: Liu, Chenlin; Zhang, Haowei; Guan, Ruili; Zou, Yuankang; Chen, Mengyu; Du, Mingrui; Luo, Wenjing; Zhang, Jianbin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HMGB1-RAGE轴在缺氧诱导小胶质细胞炎症和认知障碍中的作用，属于纯湿实验和信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The mechanisms underlying the abnormal activation of microglia affecting cognitive function under high-altitude hypobaric hypoxia (HAHH) have not been fully elucidated. This study aims to investigate the effects of HAHH on the expression of the receptor for advanced glycation end-products (RAGE) in hippocampal microglia of mice and to explore the role of RAGE inhibitors in alleviating HAHH-induced microglial inflammation and cognitive impairment. Mice were exposed to HAHH via a multi-environment simulation chamber, and RNA sequencing, qPCR, WB, flow cytometry and immunohistochemistry showed that HAHH exposome significantly increased RAGE expression in hippocampal microglia of mice (p < 0.001 vs. normoxia), which was closely related to microglial neuroinflammatory responses. RAGE inhibitor (FPS-ZM1) alleviated HAHH-induced microglial inflammation (TNF-alpha decreased by 64%, p < 0.001; CD86(+) cells decreased by 42%, p < 0.001) and improved cognitive function in mice (Y-maze novel arm time: 28.08 +/- 5.14 s vs. hypoxia 19.67 +/- 4.68 s, p = 0.016; NORT recognition index: 0.52 +/- 0.05 vs. hypoxia 0.33 +/- 0.07, p < 0.001). Mechanistic studies revealed that RAGE inhibitors reduced microglial inflammation by inhibiting the MAPK pathway and decreasing nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65. Furthermore, high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) expression increased under hypoxic conditions (p < 0.001 vs. normoxia) and positively regulated RAGE expression. HMGB1 inhibitors reduced RAGE expression and attenuated HAHH-induced microglial inflammation. Overall, the HAHH exposome induces microglial inflammation via the HMGB1-RAGE-NF-kappaB pathway. RAGE and HMGB1 inhibitors may serve as novel therapeutic strategies to mitigate HAHH-induced cognitive impairment, providing a theoretical basis for the treatment of cognitive impairment.
abstract_zh: 高海拔低压低氧（HAHH）条件下小胶质细胞异常激活影响认知功能的机制尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在探讨HAHH对小鼠海马小胶质细胞中晚期糖基化终末产物受体（RAGE）表达的影响，并探索RAGE抑制剂在缓解HAHH诱导的小胶质细胞炎症和认知障碍中的作用。通过多环境模拟舱使小鼠暴露于HAHH，RNA测序、qPCR、WB、流式细胞术和免疫组化结果显示，HAHH暴露显著增加了小鼠海马小胶质细胞中RAGE的表达（p < 0.001，与常氧相比），这与小胶质细胞神经炎症反应密切相关。RAGE抑制剂（FPS-ZM1）缓解了HAHH诱导的小胶质细胞炎症（TNF-alpha降低64%，p < 0.001；CD86(+)细胞减少42%，p < 0.001），并改善了小鼠的认知功能（Y迷宫新臂时间：28.08 +/- 5.14 s，对比低氧组19.67 +/- 4.68 s，p = 0.016；NORT识别指数：0.52 +/- 0.05，对比低氧组0.33 +/- 0.07，p < 0.001）。机制研究表明，RAGE抑制剂通过抑制MAPK通路和减少NF-kappaB p65的核转位来降低小胶质细胞炎症。此外，高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）在低氧条件下表达增加（p < 0.001，与常氧相比），并正向调控RAGE表达。HMGB1抑制剂降低了RAGE表达，并减轻了HAHH诱导的小胶质细胞炎症。总体而言，HAHH暴露通过HMGB1-RAGE-NF-kappaB通路诱导小胶质细胞炎症。RAGE和HMGB1抑制剂可能作为缓解HAHH诱导认知障碍的新型治疗策略，为认知障碍的治疗提供理论基础。
